The search returned consistent reports that Firecrawl raised a $75 million Series B. Smash Capital is named as the lead in most coverage, though one source calls it Smash Ventures.

- **Lead and co-investors:** Smash led the round, with Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures also participating. Firecrawl closed a $75M Series B led by Smash Ventures with participation from Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle and Offline Ventures.
- **Timing and purpose:** The announcement came on September 22, 2026, alongside the launch of Alexandria, a service that gives AI agents access to specialized datasets through one interface. Firecrawl announced a $75 million Series B led by Smash Capital on September 22nd and launched Alexandria.
- **Valuation:** None was disclosed. The round's valuation was not disclosed.
- **Discrepancy:** RuntimeWire reported a Form D filing showing about $82.06 million of preferred stock sold, which is roughly $7.1 million more than the announced amount, and neither disclosure explains the gap.
- **Series A figure conflict:** Dealroom puts the prior Series A at $20.7M, while Inforcapital says $14.5M. I could not resolve which is correct.

content.text:
Firecrawl raised **$75 million** in its Series B. **Smash Capital** led it. Most outlets say "Smash Capital", and one calls it "Smash Ventures". Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle and Offline Ventures also took part.

The company announced **Alexandria** alongside the round on September 22, 2026. Alexandria is a service that gives AI agents access to specialized datasets through a single interface. Coverage describes it as a knowledge or data library for agents.

The valuation wasn't disclosed. RuntimeWire also reported a Form D filing showing about $82.06M of preferred stock sold, roughly $7M more than the announced amount. Neither disclosure explains the gap.

I got all of this from one search of secondary coverage, and I didn't open the articles or check Firecrawl's own announcement.

Sources:
- [AI Weekly: Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Dealroom: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
- [RuntimeWire: Firecrawl raises $75M](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data)
- [Inforcapital: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B, launches Alexandria](https://inforcapital.com/news/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-launches-alexandria/)
- [HedgeCo: Firecrawl Raised $75 Million Series B Led by Smash Capital](https://hedgeco.net/news/?p=92045)
